paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of reference answers and test cases in the dataset. Among the entries, 38.9% have reference answers, 21.9% include test cases, and 39.2% have neither reference answers nor test cases.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of reference answers and test cases across a dataset of 1.4 million entries, as described in the paper "1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large Language Model Training." The chart is divided into three segments: the largest segment, colored pink, represents 39.2% of the dataset (549,238 entries) that have neither a reference answer nor a test case, labeled as "Null." The second largest segment, in blue, accounts for 38.9% (543,935 entries) and corresponds to entries that have a reference answer. The smallest segment, in green, represents 21.9% (306,818 entries) of the dataset that include a test case. Each segment is labeled with its category and percentage directly on the chart, and a legend in the top-left corner confirms the color coding and exact counts for each category. The chart visually emphasizes that a nearly equal proportion of entries lack both reference answers and test cases as those that have reference answers, while only a minority include test cases.
